description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1852/42 of 07.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights, encumbrances, title classifications, and property particulars for various land parcels. It contains detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, village names, and administrative divisions. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land title modifications, servitude rights, and property encumbrances without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
